scenario: Pre-existing condition, but the Plus waiver applies; covered.

coverage.reasoning: The inhaler change on 2026-06-15 falls within 90 days before the 2026-07-08 purchase, so asthma is a pre-existing condition (1.2). The Plus waiver applies: the policy was bought 7 days after the 2026-07-01 deposit and she was fit to travel on the purchase date (5.1). Covered under 2.1(a); above the 2,500 threshold, so an adjuster approves.
